main_text.p: primo quidem occurrit liberalitati, quafi in Media via conftitutæ; quam fi ample· ſeretur, cui fi adhæreat, bene habet,pro· bus eft Philaretus: fed fi paulo ulterius progrediatur (quod hic lubricum eft & perfacile ex Diaboli fraude, perge & perge ingeminantis) incidit in exceffum, nempe in prodigalitatem. Et idem eft dereli· quarum Virtutum materia & Officiis. His igitur Diaboli aftibus & dolis abjiciat Phi· laretus, fcutum Rationis: memor hanc non dicere: Perge quia incepisti,fed fæpe & fæpius: Defiste nisi inceperis, imo nisi opti· me inceperis, defiste, aut perge; fed non ideo perge, quia incepisti, aft quia Deus jubet. Scuto autem suo infcribat hoc oraculum,
main_text.head: NE QUID NIMIS.
main_text.p: Quod & nos finem huic tractatui fa· cientes, adscribimus: Ne quid nimis.

page.notes: The lower half of the page (below the heading) holds a block of faint, damaged lines that cannot be read and are left out. The final word "ETHI-" is taken as a hyphenated line end and may be an incomplete word; its continuation is not on this page.
